content_blocks.heading_text: Project Management Careers Across Raleigh's Growing Sectors
content_blocks.text:
Raleigh's position as the Research Triangle's anchor city has created sustained demand for certified project managers across technology, healthcare, government, and financial services. Red Hat, IBM, and Cisco Systems drive substantial project management hiring in the software and tech sector, while WakeMed Health & Hospitals and Duke Energy require skilled PMs to oversee complex operational and infrastructure initiatives. The State of North Carolina and City of Raleigh government agencies, along with NC State University's Centennial Campus development and the ongoing Raleigh Union Station transit hub redevelopment, represent major local projects where certified project managers play central roles. Banking and financial services employers like Fidelity Investments, Truist, and PNC Bank also maintain active demand for credentialed professionals.

PMP® certification is widely recognized and often preferred or required in Raleigh-area job postings, particularly within technology, healthcare, and government sectors—giving certified candidates a clear competitive edge. Project managers in the Research Triangle command compensation that reflects strong regional demand from the area's diverse employer base, and PMP-certified professionals generally earn a premium over non-certified peers as they advance into mid- and senior-level roles. Completing PMP Certification Training through Granite PM Academy positions you to meet that credential expectation head-on, equipping you with the skills and formal credential Raleigh employers actively seek to differentiate talent in a competitive market.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Raleigh

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and credential requirements for the PMP—they vary based on your educational background. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP prep course designed around PMI's Body of Knowledge. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and build the knowledge foundation required for exam eligibility and success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's examination fee and await approval of your credential application. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and required materials.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor feedback—to build confidence. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a test center or via remote proctoring. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before you sit for the certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, maintain your PMP by earning professional development units (PDUs) during each three-year cycle. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources to help you stay current in project-management practice and meet PMI renewal requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
